facts.fact: The AY 2026-27 return due date for persons at Sl. No. 2 of the table below Explanation 2 to s.139(1) was extended from 31 Oct 2026 to 21 Nov 2026
facts.quote: hereby extends the due date for furnishing Return of Income for the Assessment Year 2026-27 (Previous Year 2025-26) for the persons referred in sl.no.2 of the table below Explanation 2 to sub-section (1) of section 139 of the Act, from 31.10.2026 to 21.11.2026.

facts.fact: The extension is by CBDT Circular No. 07/2026 dated 28 September 2026
facts.quote: Circular No. 07/2026 F. No. 225/128/2026/ITA-II Government of India Ministry of Finance Department of Revenue Central Board of Direct Taxes New Delhi, dated 28th September, 2026

facts.fact: Sl. No. 2 covers audit cases: companies, assessees whose accounts must be audited, and partners of firms whose accounts must be audited
facts.quote: (ii) Assessee (other than a company) whose accounts are required to be audited under this Act or under any other law for the time being in force;

summary: 21 Nov 2026 (from 31 Oct 2026) for Sl. No. 2 audit cases under CBDT Circular 07/2026 dated 28 Sep 2026 confirmed; no later extension on the ITD news page as of 28 Oct 2026.
